Since 2026-09-04, at the model team’s request, replacing the
1.5x/1.5x pair the grid below chose. What overturned it: a hand-held
tablet replay recorded by the model team read Live from BOTH heads on
100% of frames at 1.5x (three device recordings, 125–153 fresh samples
each) while the same frames replayed offline at the native scales
read Replay from Papaya on every frame and from Pear on 73–100%. The
bezel and hand that betray a screen sit outside a 1.5x crop, exactly
the risk the grid’s own caveat below names. Depth still read flat, so
the combined gate held; the CNN leg alone had gone blind to replay.
The mask gain the grid measured is forfeited with this until a head
trained to see replay at 1.5x arrives.
The grid, kept for the record — 1.5x/1.5x from a device grid over the
labelled bench set (
~496 frames: ~328 genuine, 168 attack). Total error at the shipped
decision rule, two independent runs of the identical grid:
READ THE INSTABILITY FIRST. The grid is not reproducible run to run –
the matched corpus itself came out 495 then 496 frames, because the
heads run
and which frames clear the frame-quality gate
shifts. Cells move by up to ~0.015, and the top two SWAP: 1.5x/1.5x
wins the first run, 1.8x/1.5x the second.
The narrow slot’s exact
value is not resolved by this measurement
and no claim here should
rest on a 4-decimal comparison between neighbouring cells.
What survives both runs, by margins far larger than the drift: in
every narrow row, that row’s wide-1.5x cell beats that row’s wide
= 2.0x cells (the claim is per-row – read across rows it is false,
2.7x/1.5x loses to 1.5x/3.0x in both runs); and the declared
against ~0.24-0.25 for the best pair, a factor of ~2.2. BPCER goes
improve, which is what separates this from the pipeline’s known
artifact that a tighter probe reads as more confident – that failure
mode raises attack acceptance rather than quartering it.
1.5x is taken over 1.8x on a tie the data cannot break, for a reason
outside the data: 1.8x/1.5x would make the NARROW slot carry more
context than the wide one, inverting the only thing the slot names
mean.
Read the wide axis carefully too: the 3.0x and 4.0x columns are
identical in every row because the reference fit’s clamp binds at
~2.4x on this geometry, so above that the requested scale stops
changing the crop. That axis is degenerate past 2.4x, and “4.0x is the
worst column” is a statement about the clamp ceiling, not about 4.0x
of context. What the grid does say is that the WIDE slot carries the
effect, and that the two heads want the same context – so this
pairing is now two architectures on one crop rather than one head per
scale.
The grid is masks only, and context is exactly what betrays a printed
photo or a screen – border, bezel, holding hand – which a mask does
not have, so the obvious risk was a scale tuned against the one attack
class whose evidence it can afford to discard.
checks
that on CelebA-Spoof (955 images, 486 live, spoof half photo/poster/A4
and PC/pad/phone): declared 2.7x/4.0x scores BPCER 0.1049 / APCER
0.3881, retuned 1.5x/1.5x scores BPCER 0.1358 / APCER 0.3028. Attack
acceptance falls there too, so the retune is not buying masks with
print and replay. Those are
shards and the handoff heads’
training set is undocumented here, so the absolute rates may be
optimistic; the A/B is unaffected, contamination landing on both arms.
The grid was run on the E3D/E11 checkpoints; the bundled heads are
E15A/E15B since 2026-09-01 and the sweep has not been repeated on
them.
keeps 2.7x for its own reason: its frozen E15A backbone was
trained there, so moving it would move a temporal model nobody
re-measured.
declares 2.7x on BOTH slots. Its checkpoint records
and its handoff calls the crop load-bearing – “not a
hyperparameter to tune at integration time” – and it reads only the
narrow slot, so the wide figure is inert. It is set to 2.7x rather
than left at 4.0x so that a plan which ever grew a wide half could
not hand this head a context it has never seen.
Public so a host HUD can name the crop each head is reading. The
per-slot EFFECTIVE scale a frame actually reached is reported the
other way, through
— this is the contract, not
the measurement.
reads 2.7x for Quince and Papaya (one box, two patch
sizes) and 4.0x for Pear: each head at its own scales.
